text.tspan: • AdamW; learning rate: head 1e-3, adapter 1e-4, STATE 1e-5 (only when fine-tuned)
• 1-epoch linear warm-up, then cosine decay over at most 30 epochs
• best checkpoint: highest validation selective-gene Spearman; stop after 5 epochs without improvement
• test: the 27 test lines, scored once with that run’s best checkpoint
